title: modular service architecture construction fragments

specimens.name: Facade rainscreen cassette section
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 1 ONLY. ONE small cutaway cross-section of an off-white modular facade cladding cassette. Show its bent panel edge, a distinct ventilation gap and a short rear clip rail with one engaged clip; only a short fragment, no whole facade.

specimens.name: Passive ventilation louver cover
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 2 ONLY. ONE shallow rectangular passive ventilation cover fragment with three or four fixed parallel sloped vanes in a slim off-white frame, no fan, filter cartridge, moving mechanism or wall.

specimens.name: Structural glass-to-frame corner
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 3 ONLY. ONE short corner fragment of a thick clear physical glass panel bonded into an anodized aluminium frame, show a continuous dark structural adhesive edge and visible glass thickness; no entire window, no curtain-wall facade.

specimens.name: Recessed service-door jamb
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 4 ONLY. ONE short recessed metal door jamb cross-section with a return flange, a dark continuous weather seal and the short mating edge of the service panel; no entire door, handle, hinges or building.

specimens.name: Flush floor raceway cover
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 1 ONLY. ONE short cross-section of a flush floor raceway: a flat removable metal cover seated level with the adjoining floor fragment in a passive retaining channel; no cables, no moving cable carrier.

specimens.name: Modular roof-wall seam
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 2 ONLY. ONE small right-angle roof-to-wall joint fragment, with an overlapping folded metal flashing and a visible downward-facing drainage lip; no roof, wall section or building as a whole.

specimens.name: Raised-floor support pedestal
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 3 ONLY. ONE adjustable metal support pedestal with a threaded adjustment stem, a base foot and ONE partial raised-floor tile corner resting on its top plate; no extra tools or furniture.

specimens.name: Composite-metal threshold section
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 4 ONLY. ONE short cutaway threshold where a composite floor edge meets a profiled aluminium threshold, with one dark insulating isolation pad between different materials; no complete doorway or loose pieces.

any ninth specimen, extra fragment, repeated object class, substituted, merged or omitted specimen

baked cast/contact shadows, studio-product shadows, glow, bloom, rays, live display graphics or temporary FX
photorealistic PBR material-catalog rendering, rendered CAD/studio 3D look, photographic materials or filtered 3D render
generic smooth image devoid of intentional HD pixel-art clusters, missing dark chromatic selective outlines or continuous-airbrush gradients
motors, buttons, standalone connectors, lights, dashboards or any other role's standalone hardware
E2 beige rack and dense external wiring, E4 curtain-wall structures, E5 transparent holograms and levitation
repeat specimens from E3 sheets 01 or 02, complete buildings, whole doors or windows, active fans, cables, moving carriers or utility modules

era_contract.character: E3 / 2015 modular spaceport service architecture: quiet, clean, replaceable panel interfaces in engineered composites and anodized aluminium with physically functional seals, drainage, clips and support. Render as cohesive HD pixel-art fragments, not complete buildings or photorealistic catalog items.
required_signals: eight physically distinct service architecture fragments with practical attachment, load paths, ventilation and service access
short partial sections only; an element may include its necessary mating material but no complete structure
controlled off-white and graphite tones and selective chromatic outlines in the verbatim style bible
E3 modern modular fabrication and serviceability, distinct from E2 rack-test equipment
replaced_previous_language: E2 utilitarian sheet-metal rack and exposed vents give way to replaceable modular exterior cladding and flush service interfaces
E2 ordinary fastened sheet construction gives way to clip-mounted rainscreen, sealed jamb and drained roof seam
E2 exposed infrastructure paths give way to flush passive floor raceway cover without depicting moving cable carrier
forbidden_regressions: E2 laboratory cabinet hardware as main vocabulary
E4 glass curtain-wall architecture or whole buildings
repeated generic panel corners with indistinguishable functions
photorealistic architectural rendering, glowing glass or application scenes
